text:
maria: Heads-up — we saw a spike in spot preemptions in us-west-2 at ~18:12 UTC, about 40% of running GPUs got interrupted.
ajay: Oof. Any patterns? specific instance types?
maria: Mostly p4d and a100-preemptible pools. The mixed pool with smaller instances stayed stable.
diane: Were there any customer-impacting 5xxs?
maria: Error rate up ~0.6% for a few minutes, SLO alert triggered, autoscaler tried to re-provision but hit region quota.
kevin: So two failure modes: quotas + churn. We should avoid re-allocating same region immediately.
sylvia: Proposal: implement region cooldown per allocation group. If >X% preemptions in 5m, mark region as degraded for Y minutes and route to backups.
ajay: Agree. We also need model-variant fallback: degrade to smaller model (gpt-small) for non-enterprise customers when capacity constrained.
diane: Must ensure enterprise customers get reserved capacity — no fallback for them unless we failover to dedicated pool.
kevin: Right — routing policy chain: (1) preferred region, (2) same-region mixed pool (spot+on-demand), (3) fallback region, (4) smaller model variant, (5) dedicated-reserved as last resort.
ops-bot: autoscaler: scaled down spot-pool-us-west-2 from 120 -> 30 due to preemption events at 1715004200
maria: Can we add a soft quota request to cloud for buffer? but that doesn't help immediate churn.
ajay: For immediate handling, we can pre-warm a tiny on-demand buffer (e.g., 10 nodes per region) and keep a KV cache warm for top-10 prefixes.
sylvia: Suggestion: implement two counters per pool: interruption_rate and reallocation_failures. Once interruption_rate > 0.15, tag pool as 'churny' and reduce traffic weight.
kevin: Also add probabilistic routing: N% of new requests go to fallback while monitoring latency regressions.
diane: Ops checklist: update routing rules, add metrics (interruption_rate), rollback plan, and a smoke-test after deploy.
maria: I'll draft a config snippet for routing weights.
ajay: please add a CLI command to force-disable region during incident.
sylvia: config snippet:
```
routing_policies:
  - name: us-west-2_preemptible_policy
    conditions:
      - interruption_rate > 0.15
    actions:
      - reduce_weight: 0.2
      - route_to: [us-west-1, eu-west-1]
      - prewarm_on_demand: 10
```
kevin: Nice. Add customer-tier exceptions: enterprise: max_fallback_level: 1 (only region failover), standard: max_fallback_level: 3 (allow model fallback)
diane: timeline? we should have a small PR today, rollout tomorrow canary 5% traffic.
maria: I'll open PR 1715004999 and tag infra-oncall.
ajay: I'll add tests for KV cache warmup and routing unit tests.
ops-bot: incident-note: created ticket INF-732 for region churn mitigation
maria: Thanks — will sync in 30 for handover. :thumbsup:
